metadata.description: Open-source Claude Code mods: context bar, PII shield, agent deck, checklist, casual replies, notifications, question log, project colours, deploy tracker, decision log.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Live, colour-segmented context window bar with an active | passive split at 50%.

plugins.name: pii-shield
plugins.description: Masks emails, names, account numbers and secrets on screen while you screen-record.

plugins.name: agent-deck
plugins.description: Side pane showing every running subagent: model, type, task title and what it is doing.

plugins.name: checklist
plugins.description: Persistent per-repo checklist that both you and Claude can work through.

plugins.name: casual
plugins.description: Short, conversational replies and a quieter transcript.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Native desktop notifications when Claude needs you, finishes, or hits an error.

plugins.name: question-log
plugins.description: Highlights every question Claude asks and keeps a log of questions and answers.

plugins.name: project-color
plugins.description: A stable colour per project: a coloured stripe above the prompt and a colour emoji in the status line, so sessions are easy to tell apart.

plugins.name: deploy-deck
plugins.description: Live deployment tracker and panel for GitHub Actions, Vercel, Cloudflare and Render.

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: Records project decisions as ADRs in the repo that Claude and you can look up later.
